column1: # Rendered by `make fleet-sim-profile` from the cel1 site model. Edit the model, not this file.

# site network, and cel1-sim-syslog at the syslog address of the model. The rails carry Ethernet
# frames here, not InfiniBand. A guest that panics ends its QEMU process and leaves its console.
